newsitem.title: USA: AOL - 44 states reach final accord on refunds, ads.
newsitem.headline: AOL - 44 states reach final accord on refunds, ads.

text.p: Massachusetts Attorney General Scott Harshbarger and attorneys general for 43 other states said Monday they had finalized an agreement with America Online that provides refunds for consumers.
The agreement provides for refunds to consumers who file complaints with America OnLine, or any of the 44 chief legal officers within 120 days of the agreement's signing.

The on-line service ran into problems shortly after December 1, 1996 when it began offering its members a $19.95-a-month plant for "unlimited access" to the service and consumers found it difficult to get connected.

The agreement also states that AOL stop "virtually all its advertising for this month," Harshbarger said in a statement, adding that until the on-line service provider "meets its current demand, future advertising must be qualified by a disclaimer that access to the service may be limited."
Consumers who wabt to cancel their service can call 1-800-265-8008. Those who want to claim a refund, or get a month's credit, can call 1-800-827-6364.
